none: PAS CAM-FC1166: Copper-alloy Nummus Roman Coin of Constans
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ D N CONSTA-N S PF AVG ; R/ FEL TEMP REPARATIO

A copper-alloy nummus of Constans, 337-350. Mint is Trier, 348-350, Reece period 18. Obverse shows Pearl-diademed, draped and cuirassed bust right. Obverse legend reads D N CONSTA-N S PF AVG. Reverse shows Phoenix on globe right. Reverse legend reads FEL TEMP REPARATIO. Reverse fields and exergue read: / //TRP. . Condition is fine, die axis is 6 o'clock, weight is 2.44g, diameter is 16.35mm. See…
